## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- ChipLoadEngine
- recommends chip load for steel/carbide
- applies chip thinning for ae < 50%
- no chip thinning for slotting (ae = 100%)
- finishing uses lower chip load
- trochoidal uses higher chip load
